title: A decision record, as the specification reads one
description: Informative, at draft maturity. The runtime evaluation record of a decision trail, in the form spec/dialect.md section 11, Reading the record, reads it: one JSON object with an object inputs, whose member binding is read by that exact name, so a member named binding but for ASCII case is refused. The record's format and its chaining are the reference runtime's (runtime ADR-0047, spec/checkpoint-witness.md section 1), so the object stays open and no other member is described here; a binding of any value, null included, is carried. Core section 1.1 does not list this schema among the normative artifacts, so publishing it changes no format's normative status; where it and the prose differ, the prose controls and the difference is a specification defect. Outside it: that the record is one line with neither a line feed nor a carriage return, its bytes and the binding's bytes, its signature, its chain and its witness.
